messages:
nina: Heads up 1 1 Nightingale AI sent an updated onboarding draft for open models. Key asks: allow redistribution of quantized weights to HW partners, SI rehosting in managed clouds, and a co-announcement window. Any immediate red flags?

sofia: skimmed 1 only surface issues: export control/ECCN, attribution, and an open sublicensing clause that1s too broad. We should limit downstream sublicensing. Also we need to know if they want dual-license vs single-permissive.

aj: technical: need explicit list of quant formats they're ok with (q4/q8/etc) and whether conversions between formats are allowed. This impacts our packaging for appliance images.

liam: product note: marketplace bundles are ok if contract guarantees versioning and rollback. We should require a metadata header so runtime auto-detects quantization and checksum.

maria: marketing asks: 2-week embargo, one approved quote per org, approved logo assets, and allowed channels (blog, tweet, marketplace banner).

oliver: (Nightingale rep) quick clarifications: they1re okay with rehosting for distributions that "don1t modify model behavior." They1re wary of downstream derivatives. Prefer permissive CLA but open to a reseller rider.

sofia: @oliver can you confirm whether "don1t modify model behavior" excludes fine-tuning? If they1re trying to ban fine-tuning we need explicit language because that blocks many SI use cases.

oliver: will ask counsel. Tentative: they allow fine-tuning but want notification for commercial re-offerings.

nina: Can Eng prepare a redistribution clause suggestion and a list of supported formats for packaging to avoid churn?

aj: will draft a technical appendix: supported formats + conversion policy. Example snippet: ```SupportedFormats: [q4_0, q4_1, q8_0]; Conversions allowed: yes if metadata header and checksum preserved. Structural changes prohibited.```

sofia: Proposed legal negotiation language: "Distributor may redistribute model binaries in quantized or optimized forms provided redistributions include original attribution, do not create derivative models for resale without express written permission, and comply with applicable export laws." Thoughts?

liam: add a requirement for semantic regression tests on redistributed weights (simple eval suite) to catch conversion regressions before marketplace listing.

maria: co-branded announcement process: 24-hour review window for quotes/assets and shared embargo calendar.

nina: timeline: legal draft by EOD Wed, eng appendix Thu, partner counsel confirm Fri, joint announcement sync Mon. Blocked?

oliver: counsel may need 48h after I ping them; Friday confirmation is tight but possible.

sofia: not blocked, I'll queue redlines in the doc and highlight reseller language.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach NDA and export checklist here 1 https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/nda-export-checklist (automated)

nina: Great. If counsel confirms fine-tuning + ECCN by Fri we can move forward with reseller rider. I'll post action items and keep updates here. :thumbsup:

aj: posting eng appendix draft in the doc in ~2h.

maria: saving the marketing checklist to shared drive now.

oliver: pinging Nightingale counsel tonight.

sofia: queuing redlines, will tag relevant legal clauses.

nina: Next update here Friday 16:00 PT.
